preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10,000 characters.

postconditions.expression: result == any(s for s in substrings(S) if s == reverse(s) and len(s) >= len(result))
postconditions.description: The result is a palindromic substring of S with the maximum length. In case of a tie, the result is the substring with the smallest starting index.
